description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): GSV provides non-direct hire staffing support services to the Inclusive Development (ID) Hub. The contractor recruits, hires, and maintains contracted technical, advisory, professional, operational, and administrative support staff that will supply services to advance inclusive development efforts led by the ID Hub and Missions to accomplish Agency priorities. These funds support the Agency's objectives by adapting policy and foreign assistance to advance the inclusion of marginalized populations.
